title: Prove You’re Not pcstyle
description: Select every square containing a good CAPTCHA. If the verifier disagrees, you'll have to correct the record.

concept.action: Select every square containing a good CAPTCHA from a three-by-three grid of blank tiles.
concept.sequence: Submit the empty selection, dispute the rejection, then correct the verifier's prefilled appeal grid.
concept.difficulty: The correct first answer is rejected. The appeal selects all nine empty squares on your behalf, and you must clear them individually.
concept.success: File an appeal with all nine squares unselected.
